purpose: Independent source-only scoring reference; not governed knowledge and not a promotion input.

independence.method: Human adjudication against retained source captures and canonical Compact Knowledge / sections 15 and 17 boundaries. Mechanical files, hashes and coverage metadata were used only for transport and provenance.

adjudication_rules.ethos: Record an organisation's explicit self-description only; do not transfer a beneficiary, parent, network, contributor or regulator characteristic to the subject.
adjudication_rules.history: Record an event only where the retained source itself supports event identity and date/lineage; do not turn source publication/retrieval dates into event dates.
adjudication_rules.source_role: Official self-description can support attributed current self-description, not independent recognition. Regulatory filing/profile can support only its stated structured fact. Neither alone establishes independent notability.
adjudication_rules.section_16_boundary: No conduct, compliance, virtue, trust, quality, ideology or religion taxonomy label is expected.
adjudication_rules.duplicate_event: A repeated statement in two captures is one possible event, never two events merely because two sources exist.
